# iKnowAPDF (https://iknowapdf.lol) — Reference for AI Agents
> Factual overview of iKnowAPDF: what the tools do, how files are processed, pricing, limitations, and an index of guides. Short version: https://iknowapdf.lol/llms.txt

---

## 1. Overview

iKnowAPDF is a free, independent web app for working with PDFs and images, built and maintained by Yassine K. (founder and developer). Its tools process files inside the user's browser instead of uploading them to a server.

### How processing works
1. When a user selects a file, the browser reads it into memory (`ArrayBuffer`).
2. The tool processes it with client-side JavaScript libraries:
   - `pdf-lib` — reading and writing PDF structure (pages, metadata, forms, merging, splitting).
   - `pdfjs-dist` (PDF.js) — rendering pages to a canvas and extracting text.
   - `mammoth`, `docx`, `xlsx`, `pptxgenjs`, `jszip` — Office format conversion.
   - Browser APIs: Canvas (rendering, image encoding), Web Crypto (SHA-256 hashes), getUserMedia (scanner camera).
3. The result is downloaded to the user's device. The document is not sent to iKnowAPDF's servers.
4. Closing or refreshing the tab releases the file from memory. iKnowAPDF does not store copies.

Note: the website itself loads from a server, and the free version shows ads (Google AdSense and partners) and may use Google Analytics. These do not receive the contents of processed files.

---

## 2. Pricing and Limits

- **Free:** all tools, no account, no daily usage limit, no watermark added to output.
- **Optional ad-free pass:** paid once through PayPal; hides ad units in the browser where it is activated. It does not unlock additional tools and does not sync across devices.
- **File size:** no limit set by iKnowAPDF; large files are limited by the device's memory and can be slow on phones.
- **Offline:** the site can be installed as a web app, and a service worker caches pages already visited, so some tools may keep working offline. This is not guaranteed for every tool.
- **Languages:** English (https://iknowapdf.lol/), French (https://iknowapdf.lol/fr), Spanish (https://iknowapdf.lol/es), Russian (https://iknowapdf.lol/ru), Arabic (https://iknowapdf.lol/ar).

---

## 3. Tools

All tools: https://iknowapdf.lol/pdf-tools

### Compress PDF — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/compress-pdf
- **Lossless / High Quality:** clears document-level metadata and re-saves with compressed object streams. Text, vectors and images are unchanged; text stays selectable.
- **Recommended:** re-renders every page as a JPEG image at about 100 DPI (1.4x scale, quality 0.74). Text is no longer selectable.
- **Extreme:** re-renders pages at about 72 DPI (quality 0.5) for the smallest output.
- The tool returns the smallest of the original, lossless and rasterized versions, so output is never larger than the input.
- **Size targets:** pages such as https://iknowapdf.lol/compress-pdf-under-100kb, https://iknowapdf.lol/compress-pdf-under-200kb, https://iknowapdf.lol/compress-pdf-under-500kb, https://iknowapdf.lol/compress-pdf-under-1mb and https://iknowapdf.lol/compress-pdf-under-2mb size each page to the budget and run a second, tighter pass if needed. Very long documents may still exceed small targets.
- Related: https://iknowapdf.lol/compress-pdf-lossless-quality, https://iknowapdf.lol/compress-pdf-for-email

### Merge PDF — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/merge-pdf
- Combines two or more PDFs in a user-chosen file order by copying pages. Bookmarks are not carried over; form fields may not stay interactive (flatten forms first). Encrypted PDFs cannot be merged.

### Split PDF — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/split-pdf
- Extracts page ranges or splits a document into separate files. Pages are copied without re-encoding.

### Rotate PDF — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/rotate-pdf
- Rotates pages by 90°, 180° or 270°.

### Sign PDF — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/sign-pdf
- Drawn, typed or uploaded signatures, date stamps, optional diagonal watermark.
- A saved signature is stored in the browser's localStorage on that device.
- Optional summary page listing the file name, page count, number of signatures, UTC time, and SHA-256 hashes of the original and signed content (computed with Web Crypto).
- This is a simple electronic signature with an integrity record, **not** a certificate-based (PKI / PAdES) digital signature. Legal validity depends on jurisdiction and document type.

### Edit PDF — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/edit-pdf
- Edit existing text lines in place, add text boxes, shapes, highlights, images and whiteout.
- On export, edited pages are flattened into high-resolution JPEG images (text on those pages is no longer selectable); untouched pages are copied as-is.

### Scan to PDF — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/scan
- Capture pages with a webcam or phone camera, or upload photos; crop with perspective correction; filters: Original, Magic Color, B&W Clean, Grayscale; save multi-page PDFs.
- Output is image-based. **There is no OCR.**

### Convert — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/convert
- PDF to Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx) and text; Word, Excel, PowerPoint and text to PDF.
- Dedicated pages: https://iknowapdf.lol/pdf-to-word, https://iknowapdf.lol/word-to-pdf, https://iknowapdf.lol/pdf-to-excel, https://iknowapdf.lol/excel-to-pdf, https://iknowapdf.lol/pdf-to-powerpoint, https://iknowapdf.lol/powerpoint-to-pdf, https://iknowapdf.lol/pdf-to-text, https://iknowapdf.lol/text-to-pdf
- Conversions from PDF reconstruct content from the PDF's text layer; complex layouts may not convert exactly. The converter's "archival" option flattens forms and re-saves the file; it is not a validated PDF/A converter.

### Images to PDF — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/images-to-pdf
- Combines JPG, PNG or WebP images into one PDF. Pages: https://iknowapdf.lol/jpg-to-pdf, https://iknowapdf.lol/png-to-pdf, https://iknowapdf.lol/jpg-to-pdf-under-100kb, https://iknowapdf.lol/jpg-to-pdf-under-200kb

### PDF to Images — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/pdf-to-images
- Exports PDF pages as PNG or JPG images. Pages: https://iknowapdf.lol/pdf-to-jpg, https://iknowapdf.lol/pdf-to-png

### Watermark PDF — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/watermark-pdf
- Adds custom text (e.g. CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT) across pages with adjustable opacity.

### Sanitize PDF — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/sanitize-pdf
- Clears document-level metadata (title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer) and removes the catalog XMP metadata stream and /PieceInfo.
- Rebuilds the file by copying current pages into a new PDF, which drops old incremental-save revisions (bookmarks are not carried over).
- Optionally flattens interactive form fields.
- Does not rewrite EXIF data inside embedded images and does not decrypt password-protected or permission-restricted PDFs.

### Compress Image — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/compress-image
- Reduces JPG/PNG/WebP image file size in the browser. Size-target pages: https://iknowapdf.lol/compress-image-to-50kb, https://iknowapdf.lol/compress-image-to-100kb, https://iknowapdf.lol/compress-image-to-200kb

### Unlock PDF — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/unlock-pdf
- Removes the open password from a PDF when the user enters it, or removes owner restrictions (printing, copying, editing) from PDFs that open without a password. Decryption is lossless (qpdf --decrypt compiled to WebAssembly); text, links, bookmarks and forms are kept. It does not guess or crack unknown passwords. Common formats: e-Aadhaar = first four letters of the name in capitals + year of birth; e-PAN = date of birth as DDMMYYYY.

### HEIC to JPG / HEIC to PDF — https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/heic-to-jpg, https://iknowapdf.lol/tools/heic-to-pdf
- Converts iPhone HEIC/HEIF photos to JPG, PNG or a single PDF in any modern browser (native decoder in Safari, libheif/WebAssembly elsewhere). Batch conversion with ZIP download; EXIF metadata such as GPS location is not copied to the output. HEIC photos are also accepted by Images to PDF and Compress Image.

### Not offered
- OCR (text recognition), adding or removing PDF passwords, certificate-based digital signatures, validated PDF/A conversion.

## 5. FAQ

### How is iKnowAPDF different from upload-based PDF services?
Upload-based services process files on their servers. iKnowAPDF processes them in the user's browser, so the document is not sent to iKnowAPDF. The trade-off is that speed and maximum file size depend on the user's device.

### Is iKnowAPDF safe for confidential documents?
Files are not uploaded, which removes server-side storage and interception risk for the document itself. Whether a tool is acceptable for regulated data (for example under HIPAA or GDPR) is a decision for the user's organization; iKnowAPDF does not sign BAAs or make compliance certifications.

### Does compression keep text searchable?
Only the Lossless / High Quality preset. Recommended and Extreme convert pages to images.

### Can iKnowAPDF be used offline?
Partly: pages and scripts already loaded are cached by a service worker, so some tools may keep working without a connection.
